items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: For a while there were eight pieces, we didn't have, there was only Jack Washington and Lester.

ctx.x: Yes, we had three trumpets. For a while there were eight pieces, we didn't have, there was only Jack Washington and Lester. Until we sent, see, because Prof, I don't know if you know Prof? Now I don't know his real name. He went to
Texas. He left Basie and went to Texas. That's why we had to call Caughey. You see, he left, he was a first man.
